sloka: ततो बाणशतान्यष्टौ पातयामास मूर्धनि ।तस्य राक्षसराजस्य इक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनः ।। ७.१९.२० ॥
transliteration: tato bāṇaśatānyaṣṭau pātayāmāsa mūrdhani ।tasya rākṣasarājasya ikṣvākukulanandanaḥ ।। 7.19.20 ॥

translations.english: Those ministers of Ravana, namely Maricha, Shuka, Sarana, along with Prahasta, were defeated by Anaranya and fled like deer.
